div.head: Quadr Arg 12
div.ab: Crebris namque uirtutum naufragiis et habundantia scelerum saginata licentia, tantis calamitatibus ac molestis inprobitatibus mundus atteritur, ut fere nichil in eo sana mentis puritate, nichil incorrupto ueritatis instinctu fieri conqueratur; immo omnium animis, metu et miseriis certa trepidatione confusis, diram fallendi sedulitatem superintemptat, si quid et salubri pietatis recordatione preparetur.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 533 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
